title: Google Chrome adds Gemini scam and ClickFix detection
excerpt: Google Chrome introduces Gemini-powered security features to spot deceptive websites and warn users about malicious ClickFix commands.
body_html:
Google Chrome is rolling out new security protections powered by Gemini to help keep users safe from online threats. The updated browser features scam detection tools designed to identify deceptive websites in real time.

Additionally, the new protections are built to warn users if they attempt to copy suspicious commands associated with ClickFix attacks. These enhancements aim to provide better defense against social engineering tactics that trick individuals into executing harmful actions on their devices.
